  • Description
  • Additional information

Step into the next generation of iPhone with the Apple iPhone 17 (Base Model) — designed to bring Pro-level features to everyone. This sleek device delivers cutting-edge performance, brilliant visuals, and Apple’s most durable build yet.

Key Features

  • Display: 6.3″ Super Retina XDR OLED with ProMotion 120 Hz and Always-On technology.

  • Performance: Powered by the A19 chip with Apple Intelligence, ensuring smooth multitasking, gaming, and AI-driven features.

  • Camera System: Dual 48 MP Fusion cameras (Wide + Ultra-Wide) with Night Mode, Smart HDR, and 4K cinematic video recording.

  • Design & Durability: Color-infused glass and Ceramic Shield 2 protection, IP68 dust/water resistance.

  • Charging & Battery: Supports USB-C fast charging, MagSafe and Qi2 wireless charging.

  • Software: Ships with iOS 26, optimized for speed and security.
